title: AI and the Problem of Knowledge Collapse

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs for philosophical perspectives on human well-being and analyzing the frequency and diversity of the extracted entities (e.g., comparing the frequency of Western philosophers like Aristotle to non-Western philosophers like Al-Ghazali) using Shannon's Diversity Index and Pielou's Evenness Index.

Developing a simulation model to evaluate how reliance on AI-generated content leads to 'knowledge collapse' by over-representing the 'center' of a distribution and neglecting long-tail knowledge, and empirically measuring the dominance of highly frequent responses in LLM outputs.
